note: Campaigns declared for the organic experiment. A hub link may only tag a click with a name listed here (see app._hub_campaign); anything else records as content-hub.
synthetic_note: synthetic-verification tags our own end-to-end checks of the click path. Rows written under it are registered in /root/shared/synthetic_events.json and subtracted by organic_experiment_report.py, so a verification click never counts as a reader.
per_book_note: One campaign per book per channel, so qualified clicks and later royalty movement can be compared per book: pin-adhd-es, pin-bilingual-kids (Pinterest RSS), li-contab-pt (owner-posted LinkedIn).
channels_note: campaign → channel. The Pinterest feed serves only campaigns mapped to pinterest-rss, so an approved LinkedIn article is never turned into a Pin. 'none' means the campaign is not a channel: content-hub is the default label and synthetic-verification is our own testing.
